subject.title: refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should the SQLite cutover also change archive retention to keep-by-default with a 2 GB budget and immediately remove the shipped whole-store Plugin SDK methods?
rationale: These are intentional upgrade and public-contract choices that tests cannot authorize; they affect existing storage expectations and external plugin compatibility.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Land the SQLite runtime cutover while retaining shipped retention behavior and a narrow deprecated SDK transition window.

options.title: Approve coordinated break
options.body: Ship the new defaults and API removals together with explicit maintainer approval, upgrade documentation, and exact-head compatibility proof.

options.title: Split policy changes
options.body: Separate retention defaults and Plugin SDK removals into follow-up PRs so the storage migration can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Land the SQLite runtime cutover while retaining shipped retention behavior and a narrow deprecated SDK transition window.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the retention redesign and current-main integration commits containing the pending policy choices.
